figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2. The ClinEdu Framework for simulating clinical ward rounds. The system begins with Data Preparation, where a medical case is decomposed into Socratic Steps. During Agent Initialization, the system matches an objective Patient Script with a subjective persona to create a Personalized Patient, while assembling a Student Team with diverse backgrounds and knowledge gaps. The Multi-Agent Simulation unfolds in a closed-loop cycle: (1) Students independently report their clinical analysis; (2) the Tutor generates Socratic guidance based on an internal thinking process; (3) the Specialist and Safety Supervisor perform a dual-filter review for factual accuracy and professional ethics; and (4) Students formulate actions to query the Patient or seek expertise from the Specialist.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 先把 dyadic→one-to-many 的对齐问题和 group scaling 压缩为 headline；Figure 2 展开 ClinEdu 的数据准备、角色初始化和闭环；Figure 3 给出合成 patient/student 构成；Tables 1–4 把 reward rubric、主比较、外部泛化和 human/user validation 落到可读数值；Figures 4–6 与 Tables 11–12/CSR 片段检验鲁棒性、规模和纠错机制；Figures 7–29 与 Tables 5–10 将 prompts、rubrics、界面和 qualitative trace 作为复现/机制附录。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 对象均采用 Figure/Table N 加一句标题式 caption；Figure 1、2、8、Table 2、6 的 caption 最接近自包含，其他结果图常只说明比较主题，省略分母/运行数/误差定义。附录 prompt caption 短而指向性强，Figure 7/9 明确标注 truncated；Figure 24 的 caption 与 panel 标题不一致，是命名缺陷。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 主结果表使用模型行、数据集/metric 多层表头与四类 row groups；外部泛化和 user 表用紧凑任务/评价列；附录 rubric 用 Score/Tier/Description，规模/agent 鲁棒性表重复 Model+ETS/MSM/MPS/Avg block。booktabs/minimal rules 和粗体/颜色高亮稳定，但宽表在双栏缩放后需放大。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Table 1 的 IS/AQ/CS rubric 与 Eq. (1)–(3) 定义训练奖励；Figures 22–27 把 judge instructions 展开；Table 2 同时呈现 w/o RL、thinking、reward、veto 与 multi-agent 删除；Figures 4/6、Tables 11/12 和 CSR 连接到 student diversity、group size 与错误纠正机制。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 p.1–10 依赖 Figure 1–4、Tables 1–4 建立问题、系统、主结果和泛化；p.14–49 的 Table 5/6、11/12 和 Figures 5–29 补齐 dialogue scale、judge robustness、rubric、所有 agent prompt、real-user UI 和案例 trace。正文引用附录但很多 caption 不重复关键分母与判定规则。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF 字体对象以 Nimbus Roman No9 L、Computer Modern math 和 NimbusMonoPS 为主；主文图轴标签/图例与附录 prompt/code 的 monospace 角色可辨。长 prompt、宽表和 Figure 29 的混合气泡使用约 5.4–7.5 pt 小字，页面级阅读不如正文段落稳定。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 深青/蓝/橙反复表示 model series，红/浅粉/灰反复表示 prompt artifact，表格以绿色 SD 和蓝色/浅色行强调条件。角色色在 Figure 2/28/29 中有语义，但跨 quantitative figures 并非完全固定；部分浅色系列没有纹理或直接数值，因此灰度可读性中等。

most_reusable_patterns: 用“问题/规模 headline → 三阶段架构 → 主表/消融 → 鲁棒性/机制 → prompt/案例复现”的视觉叙事，让一对多系统从概念到可执行接口逐步落地。
